content: @dnd-kit/core + @dnd-kit/sortable + @dnd-kit/utilities: DndContext wraps a SortableContext of items; useSortable(id) hook (composes useDraggable+useDroppable) gives attributes/listeners/setNodeRef/transform per row. On onDragEnd, use arrayMove(items, oldIndex, newIndex) to reorder local state, then persist new sort_order values to Supabase. All 3 packages verified OK via package-legitimacy check (19M+ weekly downloads, github.com/clauderic/dnd-kit).
